name: krishimitra-monorepo
description: Root workspace to start all KrishiMitra services

scripts.dev:ml: cd ml-service && export OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES && ./venv/bin/python3 manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:5005 --noreload
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,UI,ML" --prefix-colors "green,cyan,yellow" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:ml"
